concept.hr: Zaglavlja, polu-dupleks i ponovna slanja pojedu dio nazivne propusnosti
concept.en: Overhead, half duplex and retries eat the link rate

summary.hr: Uključi i isključi zaglavlja, preambulu, dijeljeni medij i gubitke: traka nazivne propusnosti pokazuje koliko korisnih podataka stvarno stigne.
summary.en: Toggle headers, preamble, a shared medium and frame loss: the nominal-bandwidth bar shows how much useful data actually arrives.

concept.hr: Zaglavlja sama uzmu oko 5 Mb/s od 100 Mb/s, bez ikakvog kvara
concept.en: Headers alone take about 5 Mb/s of 100 Mb/s, with nothing broken

concept.hr: 88 Mb/s na vezi od 100 Mb/s: bajtovi, ne bitovi
concept.en: 88 Mb/s on a 100 Mb/s link: bytes, not bits

concept.hr: Paketi od 46 B na 1 Gb/s: korisno je samo 7 % nazivne propusnosti
concept.en: 46 B packets at 1 Gb/s: only 7 % of the nominal bandwidth is useful

concept.hr: 949,3 Mb/s od 1000: preambula i razmak stoje 1,3 %
concept.en: 949.3 of 1000 Mb/s: preamble and gap cost 1.3 %

concept.hr: Polu-dupleks: tri stanice dijele 100 Mb/s, svaka dobije 31,6 Mb/s
concept.en: Half duplex: three stations share 100 Mb/s, each gets 31.6 Mb/s
